user.description: Username from whom the process list will be shown (short option -u).

replace.description: Replace existing application instance with new one (short option -r).

no_server.description: Ignore server mode and run a new application instance (option --no-server).

server_host.description: Host to use for server communication (option --server-host).

server_port.description: Port to use for server communication (option --server-port).

graphicssystem.description: Qt drawing backend. Valid values: native, raster (option -graphicssystem).
